import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x, y, n = map(int, data[:3])
    min_diff = float('inf')
    ans_a = ans_b = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        a = x * i // y
        # candidate a
        diff = abs(x / y - a / i)
        if diff < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff
            ans_a = a
            ans_b = i
        # candidate a+1
        a += 1
        diff = abs(x / y - a / i)
        if diff < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff
            ans_a = a
            ans_b = i
    print(f"{ans_a}/{ans_b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
